title: What Your Blood Pressure Numbers Really Mean After 35
primaryKeyword: what should my blood pressure be at my age
description: 1 in 3 adults over 35 has high BP — learn ideal ranges by age, warning signs like 180/120, and what to do *today*. Check your numbers now.
reasoning: People are searching 'bp care' because they’re newly diagnosed, seeing rising numbers on home monitors, or confused by changing guidelines — especially after midlife when BP naturally climbs. They want simple, age-specific clarity (not medical jargon), immediate action steps, and reassurance about silent risks.
